proof_summary: Take the composite squarefree number \(n=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\). The gcd-sum is multiplicative and equals \(2p-1\) on primes, so it is \(610815156979325\) at this \(n\); since this value plus one is \(26n\), the relevant gcd is \(n\) and hence the quotient is \(1\).
